# Rock with snow on its upward faces. Up Z.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Rock --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.4 --location 0 0 0.18
scale 1.3 1.0 0.7
apply --scale
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.06 --seed 3
mode object
material new Stone --base-color 0.400 0.545 0.565
material new Snow --base-color 0.745 0.898 0.882 --no-slot
material slot add
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.6"
material assign Snow
mode object
shade flat
export rock.glb
